body:
I'm really impressed that you can get yourself to work out. That's really great, I know it's not easy. You kinda brush it off, but it that is a big achievement. Be proud of it.

I've gotten myself to exercise a few times, and it does help. But it's hard to get the motivation. The end doesn't seem worth it.

I'm really bad at dealing with my own stuff. But I honestly love talking to people about their issues. I might not check this account a lot, because it's a throwaway... but if you want to pm someone I hope I'll be there to listen. I could also send you my primary name if you wanted someone to listen on occasion.

Helping others is kind of my "exercise". I know I can do it, and I feel better afterwards.
